title: An integrated approach to the structural characterization, long-term toxicological and anti-inflammatory evaluation of Pterospermum rubiginosum bark extract.
authors: Anish, Rajamohanan Jalaja; Mohanan, Biji; Aswathy, Thankamani Ravikumar; Nair, Aswathy; Radhakrishnan, K V; Rauf, Arun A
one_liner_zh: 该文研究植物提取物的抗炎与毒理评价，仅含NF-kB蛋白的分子对接，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE OF STUDY: Pterospermum rubiginosum is an evergreen plant in Western Ghats, India, used by traditional tribal healers due to its excellent biological potential for treating inflammation and pain relief procedures. The bark extract is also consumed to relieve the inflammatory changes at the bone fractured site. The traditional medicinal plant in India have to be characterized for its diverse phytochemical moieties, its interactive multiple target sites, and to reveal the hidden molecular mechanism behind the biological potency. AIM OF THE STUDY: The study focussed on plant material characterization, computational analysis (prediction study), toxicological screening (In vivo), and anti-inflammatory evaluation of P. rubiginosum methanolic bark extracts (PRME) in LPS-induced RAW 264.7 cells. MATERIALS AND METHODS: The pure compound isolation of PRME and their biological interactions were used to predict the bioactive components, molecular targets, and molecular pathways of PRME in inhibiting inflammatory mediators. The anti-inflammatory effects of PRME extract were evaluated in the lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-induced RAW264.7 macrophage cell model. The toxicity evaluation of PRME was performed in healthy 30 Sprague-Dawley experimental rats, were randomly divided into five groups for toxicological evaluation for 90 days. The tissue levels of oxidative stress and organ toxicity markers were measured using the ELISA method. Nuclear magnetic resonance spectroscopy (NMR) was performed to characterize the bioactive molecules. RESULTS: Structural characterization revealed the presence of vanillic acid, 4-O-methyl gallic acid, E-resveratrol, gallocatechin, 4'-O-methyl gallocatechin, and catechin. Molecular docking of NF-kB exhibited significant interactions with vanillic acid and 4-O-methyl gallic acid with binding energy -351.159 Kcal/Mol and -326.5505 Kcal/Mol, respectively. The PRME-treated animals showed an increase in total GPx and antioxidant levels (SOD and catalase). Histopathological examination revealed no variation in the liver, renal and splenic tissue's cellular pattern. PRME inhibited the pro-inflammatory parameters (IL-1beta, IL-6, and TNF-alpha) in LPS-induced RAW 264.7 cells. The protein level of TNF-alpha and NF-kB protein expression study brought out a notable reduction and exhibited a good correlation with the gene expression study. CONCLUSION: The current study establishes the therapeutic potential of PRME as an effective inhibitory agent against LPS-activated RAW 264.7 cells induced inflammatory mediators. Long-term toxicity evaluation on SD rats confirmed the non-toxic nature of PRME up to 250mg/body weight for 3 months.
abstract_zh: 研究民族药理学意义：Pterospermum rubiginosum 是印度西高止山脉的一种常绿植物，传统部落治疗师因其优异的生物潜力而用于治疗炎症和疼痛缓解程序。树皮提取物也被用于缓解骨折部位的炎症变化。印度的传统药用植物需对其多样的植物化学部分、交互的多靶点位点进行表征，并揭示其生物效力背后的隐藏分子机制。研究目的：本研究聚焦于植物材料表征、计算分析（预测研究）、毒理学筛选（体内）以及PRME（P. rubiginosum 甲醇树皮提取物）在LPS诱导的RAW 264.7细胞中的抗炎评估。材料与方法：通过PRME的纯化合物分离及其生物交互作用，预测PRME在抑制炎症介质中的生物活性成分、分子靶点和分子通路。在脂多糖（LPS）诱导的RAW264.7巨噬细胞模型中评估PRME提取物的抗炎效果。PRME的毒性评估在30只健康的Sprague-Dawley实验大鼠中进行，随机分为五组，进行90天的毒理学评价。使用ELISA方法测量组织水平的氧化应激和器官毒性标志物。采用核磁共振波谱（NMR）表征生物活性分子。结果：结构表征揭示了香草酸、4-O-甲基没食子酸、E-白藜芦醇、没食子儿茶素、4'-O-甲基没食子儿茶素和儿茶素的存在。NF-kB的分子对接显示与香草酸和4-O-甲基没食子酸有显著交互作用，结合能分别为-351.159 Kcal/Mol和-326.5505 Kcal/Mol。PRME处理的动物显示总GPx和抗氧化剂水平（SOD和过氧化氢酶）增加。组织病理学检查显示肝脏、肾脏和脾脏组织的细胞模式无变化。PRME在LPS诱导的RAW 264.7细胞中抑制了促炎参数（IL-1β、IL-6和TNF-α）。TNF-α和NF-kB蛋白表达研究显示显著减少，并与基因表达研究良好相关。结论：本研究确立了PRME作为有效抑制LPS激活的RAW 264.7细胞诱导炎症介质的治疗潜力。对SD大鼠的长期毒性评估确认了PRME在250mg/体重剂量下持续3个月的无毒性质。
